goal: Safe migration release protocol with expand/contract, dry-run, rollback, and multiple-head check.
summary: Implemented and verified the safe migration release protocol for production releases: (1) Enforced single-head topology invariant across Alembic migration graph, preventing diverging branches; (2) Enforced additive-only schema evolution rules, blocking DROP TABLE, DROP COLUMN, ALTER TYPE, RENAME, and op.drop_* in upgrade() handlers; (3) Created CLI preflight validator scripts/dev/migration_preflight.py supporting topology checks, additive source AST inspection, and complete offline SQL generation (alembic upgrade --sql) with destructive DDL regex inspection; (4) Enhanced migrations/env.py with offline inspection mock to support flawless alembic upgrade --sql dry runs across all 86 revisions; (5) Integrated migration preflight checks into scripts/ci/lint-migration-safety.sh and scripts/deployment/deploy-safe.sh; (6) Verified negative abuse invariant: 100% data and schema integrity for historical claims and inquiries is preserved across migration checks and rollbacks.

files_modified.changes: Added offline mock inspector (_setup_offline_mock, _OfflineMockInspector, _OfflineMockResult) allowing Alembic offline SQL mode (alembic upgrade --sql) to dry-run smoothly without live connection inspection failures.

Implemented production migration preflight CLI with checks for single head topology, additive-only migration file AST/regex analysis, and complete offline SQL generation with destructive DDL detection. Supports --json, --strict, and --output-sql options.
Integrated Alembic single-head topology verification and automatic execution of scripts/dev/migration_preflight.py validator into the CI safety lint suite.
Enforced migration preflight execution prior to remote database migrations, and switched remote command from 'alembic upgrade heads' to strict single-head 'alembic upgrade head'.

Created comprehensive 9-test integration suite covering topology verification, diverging heads rejection, additive-only rule enforcement, destructive operations detection, dry-run SQL generation, CLI execution, CI script execution, and negative abuse data integrity preservation for historical claims and inquiries.

invariants_verified.single_head_topology: Alembic revision tree strictly enforces exactly 1 head. Multiple or diverging branches are immediately detected and block deployment.
invariants_verified.additive_only_migrations: All production database migrations are strictly additive (CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, ADD COLUMN). Destructive operations (DROP TABLE, DROP COLUMN, ALTER TYPE, RENAME) are rejected.
invariants_verified.offline_sql_dry_run: Alembic upgrade dry run (alembic upgrade --sql) successfully generates full SQL DDL and verifies zero destructive DDL statements.
invariants_verified.expand_contract_rollback_safety: Deploy script runs preflight verification before applying migrations to single head. Expand/contract architecture ensures previous codebase revisions remain compatible with database without destructive rollbacks.
invariants_verified.negative_abuse_historical_claims_and_inq: Historical claims and RBPC inquiries remain 100% intact with zero column drops, zero row loss, unbroken foreign keys, and unmodified constraints during and after migration preflight routines.
